fails against broken code. A grep guard that passes against a broken
codebase converts an unknown into a false assurance, which is worse than
having no guard — and this project has already shipped one `sed` control
`verified` entries record a mutation that was applied, observed to fail,
and reverted. `grandfathered` is the ratchet: guards that predate this
registry and have no recorded control. That list may shrink and must never
grow — `negative-controls.test.ts` fails on a new structural guard with no
To clear a grandfathered entry: apply the mutation, run the suite, confirm
the guard fails, revert, and move it into `verified` with what you saw.
Never `git checkout` the file to revert if you have uncommitted work in it;
copy it aside first. That mistake has already cost this project a block of
Rows marked `source: transcribed-at-merge` had their control run on the

could not be registered there because this file lives on #265. Transcribed
